# Changelog — skill-repository-versioning

## 1.2.0 — 2026-08-01

### Changed

- Defers to a stronger repository-local release-maintenance skill when one exists, preventing competing release protocols.

## 1.1.0 — 2026-07-06

### Changed

- Declared in-place repository output behavior and clarified repo-wide versus per-skill version responsibilities.

## 1.0.0 — 2026-07-01

### Added

- Introduced reusable pre-commit checks for skill inventory, skill versions, plugin releases, and release notes.
